protocol_assumptions: Paper specifies pretrained ResNet50, 20 epochs, 1cycle, max_lr=1e-4, 3 repetitions, entire AffectNet test partition.

The metric package does not contain the Appendix A training implementation. Optimizer, batch size, classification head, augmentation, normalization and scheduler details below are declared reimplementation choices, not claimed paper facts.
torchvision ImageNet1K V1 initialization, 7-way linear head, full backbone training; AdamW; ImageNet normalization; resize to 224; optional horizontal flip; final epoch evaluation only.
AffectNet official validation partition is used as the held-out test partition, not for tuning or selecting checkpoints. This mapping must be checked against original author artifacts if available.
FairFace gender predictions must remain linked to their own images. The scrambled anonymous author CSV must never be row-wise joined to images.
